name: Full Tilt
description: Full Tilt is a pinball game created for a collaborative game production class. The soundtrack has a signature jazzy sound that aimed to capture an old fashioned, unique pub pinball vibe.

name: Snowfall on the bayou
description: This original soundtrack was created for a semester-long collaborative game production class. The music was designed to capture the lonely yet strangely peaceful atmosphere of a post-apocalyptic winter. The soundtrack received Honorable Mention (Second Place) in Music at the 2026 G.A.N.G. Student Competition.

name: Super Mario Gravity
description: Super Mario Gravity is a Super Mario Galaxy 2 mod created by Louis Miles; first released as a demo in 2016, then a second demo in 2022. It is still currently being worked on. The soundtrack aims to recreate the same musical and electronic style used in the original Super Mario Galaxy games.
creator: Louis Miles

name: Super Mario Another Galaxy
description: Super Mario Another Galaxy is a Super Mario Galaxy 2 mod by the SMAG Team. It's an exciting project with unique galaxies and levels.
creator: SMAG Team

name: The Sin Prince
description: The Sin Prince is an unreleased passion project. It's a dark and moody platformer game with rpg elements. The soundtrack uses a mix of orchestral and electronic sounds.

name: Tabula Rasa
description: This is the first Pokémon fan-game I composed music for, well before I had more professional experience. It gave me a fair amount of experience in making various battle and area themes in a retro style.

name: Other Pieces
description: Miscellaneous personal compositions and sound experiments.
